intelligence.essence: One system, not a pile of apps: this family states the architecture as law — one universal app starting with Personal, the Law of One built into the code (all connected, each vault one's own), the Super Brain as the citizen's own, and the gauge law corrected to suit the gauge to the situation. The correction matters as much as the law: an earlier absolute (one gauge everywhere) is refined by situation, in public, without breaking the hierarchy the gauge serves. Architecture here is not a diagram; it is the set of decisions every later builder is forbidden from re-deciding.
intelligence.human_view: Think of a house with many rooms. The rooms are different — kitchen, study, bedroom — but it's one house, one roof, one front door, and your bedroom is still yours when guests are in the kitchen. Nobody wants to carry four sets of keys to four separate cottages and call it a home.
intelligence.child_view: Your class is one class — everyone learns together and helps each other. But your desk is YOUR desk, and your drawings in it are yours. Being one class doesn't mean everyone can take your drawings. It's both things at once.
intelligence.grandma_view: A family is like that too: one family, shared table, shared stories — and still, you don't open your sister's letters. Togetherness was never the same as no boundaries. It's good to see a computer system finally written that way round.
intelligence.ai_view: Build new worlds as configurations of the universal app, never as new apps. Assert vault ownership in data-layer tests for every shared feature. Apply gauge-by-situation with the hero hierarchy invariant. File rule corrections at the rule's home, with the situation named.
intelligence.what_it_means: Every multi-app estate drifts toward a pile of disconnected tools unless the oneness is load-bearing: one app shape carrying Personal, Business and Space; one network where connection never cancels ownership. The Law of One phrasing is precise about the tension — all connected BUT all individual — and the code is asked to hold both halves at once. The gauge correction shows how the canon stays alive: a rule is refined by a named situation, and the refinement is filed where the rule lives.

page.machine: 1) One universal app shape serves Personal, Business and Space; per-world reinvention is a defect. 2) Connection never overrides ownership: shared intelligence, private vaults, enforced in the data layer. 3) The citizen's Super Brain view is theirs; seats operate it only under the citizen's direction. 4) Gauge selection suits the situation (calculator vs dashboard standard), with the number-hero hierarchy invariant across all gauges.
page.why_it_matters: Citizens were promised one world that runs everything, not another folder of apps. This essence is the architectural receipt: the oneness is in the code, ownership survives connection, and the rules that govern both can be corrected without collapsing — which is what makes the promise durable instead of decorative.
page.how_it_connects: This essence is batch 8's E7 panel; its raw family spans SN-2547 to SN-2556 (Privacy — The Trust Story → Try the Pricing Speedometer for the Minis), and it sits in the standing sequence of sixty essences that came before it — each one checked against the census coverage map for zero overlap before it was written.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: For you, Shawn, this means this stratum of the record no longer has to be re-read note by note: its law is stated once, whole, in words a cold reader can use — and the hundred raw notes beneath it are accounted for, by number, in the Distills line.
page.the_learning: One app, one network, each vault one's own — and a law that can be corrected in public is stronger than a law that can't.
